summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item code; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not run: per instructions, no tests, Black, or mypy were executed, so these are unverified. Nothing committed.
